title: How Crustdata built its sales team with Contrario
summary: Crustdata had one account executive and needed a full sales team. The bar was the hard part: every hire had to be technical enough to sell a developer-first data product, and Crustdata had already turned away vendors that sent volume instead of quality.
body_markdown: Crustdata provides real-time B2B company and people data through simple APIs, powering the AI sales, recruiting, and investment tools that builders rely on. Backed by Y Combinator and a $6M seed round, the company needed a go-to-market team, and it needed sellers who could hold their own with the developers they'd be selling to.
